result.document_summary: A page fragment of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3, Articles 4 and 5) covering cannabis business tax enforcement provisions and the Transient Occupancy Tax on hotels, RV parks and campgrounds; despite the page URL, it contains no algorithmic rent-setting text.
result.notes: No rules in the six in-scope categories appear in this part. The text covers criminal penalties and severability for a business tax article (Ch. 3, Art. 4) and the Transient Occupancy Tax on stays of less than one month (Ch. 3, Art. 5), which is not residential long-term rental regulation. The URL references the algorithmic rent-setting division (San Diego Municipal Code 98.1103), but its text is not included in this part.
